commit 5fa0cb2f26a5393713a72199d3995f947277a7cc Author: Andrei AuthorDate: Tue Jul 14 06:17:45 2026 +0000 Commit: mkmelin@iki.fi CommitDate: Tue Jul 14 06:19:51 2026 +0000 Bug 2054189 - Only lock panes along their flexible axis when resizing with the window. r=arschmitz In Classic view the folder pane is a full-height column spanning the thread, splitter, and message rows. Locking its height inflates the minimum of every row it spans, preventing the thread pane from shrinking (bug 2054189) and leaving a gap above the message pane when the locked size goes stale (bug 2054237). Manage resize-lock-ids per layout in PaneLayout instead of hardcoding it in about3Pane.xhtml, so classic layout only locks the thread pane. Adds a regression test asserting the classic layout pane geometry after startup size restore, window resizes, message pane toggles, and splitter drags. Locking its height + // inflates the minimum of every row it spans, preventing the thread + // pane from shrinking and leaving a gap above the message pane. + this.#configureMessagePaneSplitter("vertical", ["threadPane"]); break; } } + + /** + * Point the message pane splitter at the right resize axis and lock + * targets for the current layout. + * + * @param {"vertical"|"horizontal"} direction - The resize direction. + * @param {string[]} lockIds - IDs of the panes to lock while resizing with + * the window. + */ + #configureMessagePaneSplitter(direction, lockIds) { + this.messagePaneSplitter.setAttribute("resize-lock-ids", lockIds.join(",")); + this.messagePaneSplitter.resizeDirection = direction; + } } customElements.define("pane-layout", PaneLayout, { extends: "body" }); diff --git a/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser.toml b/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser.toml index d5e0aca9fa1..3e87eb5bb84 100644 --- a/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser.toml +++ b/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser.toml @@ -102,6 +102,8 @@ tags = ["compact"] ["browser_openingMessagesWithoutABackingView.js"] +["browser_paneSplitterGaps.js"] + ["browser_readMsgs.js"] tags = ["vcard"] diff --git a/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_paneSplitterGaps.js b/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_paneSplitterGaps.js new file mode 100644 index 00000000000..8e1c59f4477 --- /dev/null +++ b/mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_paneSplitterGaps.js @@ -0,0 +1,323 @@ +/* This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public + * License, v. 2.0. In Classic layout, the + * resize-with-window pane locks must never break the pane geometry: the + * folder pane always spans the full window height, the thread pane, message + * pane splitter and message pane tile their column without gaps, and the + * thread pane can always be dragged down to its minimum height. + * + * The assertions here deliberately check the resulting geometry instead of + * implementation details (locked inline styles), so they should catch + * stale-lock bugs regardless of which code path triggers them. The waits use + * the splitter's "--messagePaneSplitter-height" variable, which is "0px" + * while collapsed and returns to "100%" once the splitter has finished + * asynchronously applying a restored size. + */ + +"use strict"; + win.resizeTo(win.outerWidth, win.outerHeight - 350); + await TestUtils.waitForCondition( + () => body.getBoundingClientRect().height < bodyHeightBeforeShrink - 300, + "the window should shrink" + );
